scenes.caption: Keep the cord stump clean and dry
scenes.narration_line: Keep your baby’s cord stump clean and dry every day.

scenes.caption: Wash hands before touching the cord
scenes.narration_line: Always wash your hands well before touching the cord area.

scenes.caption: Do not apply dung or other harmful substances
scenes.narration_line: Never put dung, mud, or other harmful things on the cord.
safety_points: Avoid harmful substances like animal dung on the cord.

scenes.caption: Watch for signs of infection
scenes.narration_line: Watch for redness, pus, or swelling around the cord stump.
safety_points: Learn to recognize signs of umbilical cord infection.
